facts.fact: Statutory Instrument No. 67 of 2024, made by the Minister of Internal Affairs under section 85 of the Registration of Persons Act, Cap. 332, amends the Registration of Persons Regulations, 2015, showing the Act is in force as an Act of Parliament with regulations under it.

The Registration of Persons (Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (S.I. No. 67 of 2024), made 12 August 2024 under the Act, amend regulation 19 of the Registration of Persons Regulations, 2015 so a national identification card is valid for eleven years, deemed in force from 20 November 2015.
